description_en: Retrieves a member of a workspace
name: GetMember

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The user UID. For more information about how to view the user UID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449133.html. You must specify either UserId or MemberId. You cannot specify both
parameters.help_zh:
用户UID。如何查看用户UID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449133.html。
UserId与MemberId必须指定一个，不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The member UID. You must specify either UserId or MemberId. You cannot specify both
parameters.help_zh: 成员UID。UserId与MemberId必须指定一个，不能同时指定
parameters.name: member_id

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the member was created. The time is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and the format is ISO 8601
GmtCreateTime.title_en: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
GmtCreateTime.title_zh: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

items.description_en:
The role name. For more information about the mapping between role names and permissions, see List of roles and permissions (https://pai.console.aliyun.com/?spm=api-workbench.API%20Explorer.0.0.7a862392uO09Se\&regionId=cn-shanghai#/workspace/permission).
Possible values:

PAI.AlgoDeveloper: Algorithm developer.

PAI.AlgoOperator: Algorithm O\&M.

PAI.LabelManager: Labeling administrator.

PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper: MaxCompute developer.

PAI.WorkspaceAdmin: Administrator.

PAI.WorkspaceGuest: Guest.

PAI.WorkspaceOwner: Owner
